statement: Between 2026-09-13 and 2026-10-13, CENTCOM, the U.S. Department of Defense, or the Israeli Defense Forces will confirm at least one coalition service member killed or wounded in action from Iranian or IRGC-aligned action in the Strait of Hormuz, Gulf of Oman, or wider Persian Gulf theater.
resolution: TRUE if CENTCOM, DoD, or IDF confirms, with wire-service corroboration (Reuters, AP, or AFP), a coalition KIA or WIA from Iranian or IRGC-aligned action in the Hormuz theater between 2026-09-13 and 2026-10-13. FALSE otherwise by 2026-10-15.
failure_condition: No coalition killed-in-action or wounded-in-action casualty from Iranian or IRGC-aligned action in the Hormuz theater is confirmed and wire-corroborated before the deadline.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
